overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on optimization algorithms for fine-tuning LLMs rather than extensive NLG evaluation. The NLG tasks are evaluated as downstream applications to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed HELENE optimizer. Evaluation is limited to standard automatic metrics (accuracy, F1) without human or LLM-based assessment.
